solution: Then × 1.05 × 0.8 × 1.15 = 38,640. The multiplier is 0.966, so three years ago it was 38,640 ÷ 0.966 = 40,000.

question: A 50-litre mixture of milk and water has 10% water. How many litres of water must be added to make the water 50% of the mixture?
solution: The milk stays 90% of 50 = 45 litres. When water is 50%, milk is 50%, so the mixture is 45 × 100/50 = 90 litres. Water to add: 90 − 50 = 40 litres.
